body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/33493

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1860

## What changed

`SamplingBatchInfo` stores overlap-mode accumulated additive penalties in `acc_additive_penalties`, but DFlash/DSPARK verification still queried the nonexistent former name `acc_linear_penalties`. This change reads the current field in both consumers, broadcasts the adjustment over every verify position, and prevents DSPARK's no-adjustment fast path when an accumulated adjustment is present.

The regression fails on the recorded base with four failures: the accumulated adjustment (including a `-inf` stop-token mask) is omitted for one- and multi-token verify blocks, composition with logit bias is incomplete, and the DSPARK predicate incorrectly returns true. It passes after the correction, with independent boundary cases for block size, batch rows, dtype conversion, negative infinity, logit bias, and the true no-adjustment case.

## Reproduce and validate

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-16e675513d6c/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_verify_logits_adjustments.py
HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-16e675513d6c/venv/bin/python reports/j-16e675513d6c/gfx950_numerical_check.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-16e675513d6c/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_logits.py
pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/speculative/dflash_utils.py python/sglang/srt/speculative/dspark_components/dspark_verify.py test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_verify_logits_adjustments.py reports/j-16e675513d6c/gfx950_numerical_check.py reports/j-16e675513d6c/result.json reports/j-16e675513d6c/investigation.md
```

Focused regression: 5 passed. Existing DFlash logits coverage passed. On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (`gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-`), the affected GPU tensor operation exactly matched an explicit CPU row-loop reference with maximum finite absolute error 0.0 and preserved the `-inf` stop-token mask.

Raw failing-before/passing-after and GPU outputs are retained under `reports/j-16e675513d6c/raw/`; the structured claims are in `reports/j-16e675513d6c/result.json`.

## Limitations

The reported DeepSeek-V4-Flash serving command requires TP4 and model weights. This job had one gfx950 GPU and no qualified weights, so I did not claim a full-model, semantic-accuracy, or distributed serving reproduction. The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the DeepSeek-V4 DSPARK architecture and was not substituted for it.

Current DFlash decode preparation also does not visibly use the ordinary/EAGLE penalty token-count accumulation hook. Whether that delays lifting `min_new_tokens` suppression needs qualified model-level follow-up; it is recorded in the report and intentionally not mixed into this narrow stale-field correction.
title: fix(speculative): apply DSPARK additive penalties
